card.name: Number slot before weeks or days
card.fires_on: The space or quantity word (such as "several") right after a duration preposition like "for", "after", "beyond" or "initial", just before a number of weeks, days or months. It appears in dosing and treatment-duration sentences.

modes.label: Space before duration number
modes.description: Blank space after for/after/beyond/than, where a number of weeks or days comes next.
modes.example: Begin treatment at 30 mg once daily for<< >>1 week, to allow patients to adjust

modes.label: Vague quantity word
modes.description: The word "several" standing in for the duration before months.
modes.example: requires<< several>> months or longer of sustained pharmacologic therapy
